summary: Provides a generic panel-widget component with layout, panel interaction, look, child alignment, drag/drop, extension, and common clone/viewer controls for custom UI widgets.

key_params.name: x
key_params.note: Horizontal panel position relative to the parent

key_params.name: y
key_params.note: Vertical panel position relative to the parent

key_params.name: fixedaspect
key_params.note: Keep a fixed aspect ratio using width or height

key_params.name: hmode
key_params.note: Fixed, fill, or anchor-driven horizontal sizing

key_params.name: vmode
key_params.note: Fixed, fill, or anchor-driven vertical sizing

key_params.name: alignallow
key_params.note: Allow or ignore parent alignment rules

key_params.name: multitouch
key_params.note: Parent, built-in first-touch, or disabled multi-touch handling

key_params.name: clickthrough
key_params.note: Ignore mouse clicks on this panel

key_params.name: align
key_params.note: Child layout: rows, columns, directions, grid, or network-node matching

key_params.name: fit
key_params.note: Scale children to fit width, height, or best fit

key_params.name: crop

key_params.name: drag

key_concepts: Layout Page fixed, fill, and anchor sizing
Panel Page display, enable, click-through, and multi-touch controls
Look Page background, borders, disabled colors, and opacity
Children Page alignment and fit behavior
Extensions Page for Python widget behavior
common_gotchas: Widget COMP is a generic panel/widget shell; domain behavior comes from children, extensions, callbacks, or custom parameters.
Display can trigger layout processing; use opacity for simple visual hiding when interaction/layout should remain stable.
Enable Off prevents panel interaction but can still show the widget with disabled look settings.
Built-in multi-touch handles only the first touch and can conflict with Multi Touch In DAT scripts.
Click Through ignores mouse clicks even when the panel is visible.
Fill and Anchor modes depend on the parent panel dimensions and can move or stretch unexpectedly when the parent changes.
Depth Layer ties are ordered by operator name among siblings at the same hierarchy level.
Child Fit overrides child justification controls; Align and Offset can overwrite each other in child layout.
Margins are absolute pixels and may not be reflected in the node's panel viewer.
Use drag/drop callbacks for modern custom behavior rather than relying on legacy drag scripts.
build_relevance: 2021.10000+ custom panel widget shell and child layout controls
